consequence.statement: A new optional feature was added; the evidence states no operational consequence for existing setups.

original.statement: An option to set the Gateway status address was added to the Kubernetes Gateway API provider.

decision.reason: [ev-3f297f766443] lists this under v3.0.0 "Enhancements" as "Add option to set Gateway status address". The wording describes a new option that operators choose to use, so an environment that does nothing would not use it. The evidence names nothing that fails, is rejected, stops working or must be migrated. It also doesn't describe the default Gateway status address, so "none" (informational) is the best-supported kind, but only by inference.
